is: The domain's source: `elements` holds the nouns as plain values, and `ports` holds the traits they are served through.
conventions: Ports are `#[async_trait(?Send)]`: in the browser no future is Send, so no port may require it.

fs.name: elements/
fs.role: the value types: chat, message, user

fs.name: lib.rs
fs.role: crate façade: `pub mod elements; pub mod ports;`

fs.name: ports.rs
fs.role: façade re-exporting the port traits, AuthStatus and PortError

fs.name: ports/
fs.role: one file per port (authorization, dialogs, history, outbox) plus errors.rs (PortError: SignedOut, ChatNotFound, Transport)
